strengths_deep_dive: The Morocco Foundation addresses severe educational gaps in rural Morocco through mobile outreach programs. By utilizing <cite id="3">school caravans and community workshops</cite>, the charity delivers direct literacy and social support into geographically isolated areas. Its lean operational structure allows it to reach individuals at <cite id="2">just $8.15 per beneficiary</cite>. Additionally, the organization holds <cite id="2">8.5 months of working capital</cite>, ensuring it can sustain its current direct aid activities in the short term despite revenue volatility.
rich_narrative.summary: The Morocco Foundation works to fight poverty and improve literacy in remote, rural Moroccan communities through specialized initiatives <cite id="3">including school caravans and educational workshops</cite>. Operating on a modest budget, the foundation recorded <cite id="2">$76,622 in total revenue in FY2025</cite>. Despite its small financial footprint, the organization maintains exceptional direct cost efficiency, serving rural beneficiaries at <cite id="2">an estimated $8.15 per person</cite> across its mobile educational and health caravans. However, public reporting is extremely limited. The charity filed <cite id="2">a reported program expense data unavailable</cite> on its latest financial filings, leaving its formal expense allocation unclear to donors. Furthermore, <cite id="1">Charity Navigator has not fully rated the organization</cite>, and third-party transparency indicators remain low. Donors considering support must balance the foundation's hyper-local reach and low cost per beneficiary against significant reporting gaps and small organizational scale.
